description: This file defines a 'Style' class with methods for handling CSS styles in a rich text editor, including retrieving, applying, and manipulating styles on DOM nodes and ranges.

classes.name: Style
classes.description: A class providing methods to get, set, and manipulate CSS styles within a rich text editing context.

methods.name: jQueryCSS
methods.description: Workaround for old jQuery versions to get CSS properties as an object.

methods.name: fromNode
methods.description: Extracts style information from a DOM node.

methods.name: stylePara
methods.description: Applies style information to paragraph nodes within a range.

methods.name: styleNodes
methods.description: Inserts or styles nodes within a range, optionally expanding closest siblings.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Retrieves current style information at the cursor position or selection.
